name: RC2A1_HOTFIX
scope: Hotfix only, no new features: arcade records carry the round availableMs before the local score calculation (host = server at first calculation), recompute falls back to rd.availableMs, tablet checklist wording. Scoring, timers and layout unchanged.
fixes: commitArcadeScores → arcadeRecords(): every arcade record has the authoritative round availableMs; finalizeRound uses it as local fallback, stores it on the round and sends it to the server (RC2-A computed 200 locally and relied on score.server_override)
recomputeAllRounds and SS.recomputeTotals use rd.availableMs for historic records without availableMs
Checklist Pulsantiere: "N tablet collegati · M squadre manuali" instead of "N / N collegate"
QA erratum: the RC2-A report wrongly stated score.verified for the Photopuzzle; real logs attached
featuresFromRC2A: Scoring show_speed (default): correct = round(300 - 100 * elapsed / available), clamped 200..300, real server-measured ms; no measured time = 200; one manually entered CORRECT answer makes all correct answers of the round 200 (no speed bonus); wrong -100 and omission policy unchanged
availableMs per round (duration + added seconds, pauses excluded), kept by the server (authoritative, persisted) and stored on every response; CSV columns tempo_disponibile_ms and bonus_velocita
Old saved games keep their profile (show_standard 300/275...); RC1 preferences migrate once to the new default

Standard times in one place (engine/timer.js DEFAULTS): questions 15 s (also with image), photopuzzle/abbinamenti/indovina/chain/ghigliottina 45 s; explicit seconds always win; normalizer no longer writes defaults; 60 s game minimum removed; tablet round duration = stage timer
Bundled pack Arte romana 3.6.0: explicit 30/60 s removed (declared); external packs untouched
Round result screen: outcome, time, points of the round; no positions, podium colours or totals; top-down cascade
Leaderboard only on command: end of content shows FINE DEI CONTENUTI; ★ CLASSIFICA always starts the reveal from last place; mid-game reveal ends with TORNA AL GIOCO, final with TERMINA PARTITA

Stage readability: question screen without footer/mascot, answers fill the height (2x2 when short), js/stage-fit.js picks the largest text that fits between min and max % of screen height; question/result/end screens fill 4:3 windows
Explicit fullscreen button on projector window and /show (F key, hide, reappears after ESC, F11 hint if the browser refuses), regia fullscreen button; click-anywhere fullscreen removed
Player text keyboard: 5 full-height rows, keys >= 44 px, accents, apostrophe, hyphen, digits behind 123, INVIA inside the keyboard, single send, clear green confirmation
knownLimitations: Phone portrait QWERTY letters are 30-33 px wide (height >= 44 px).
Popup projector window and fullscreen could not be exercised in the embedded test browser (popups/fullscreen blocked); /show was tested.
Barocco/Preistoria and external packs keep explicit 30/60 s until the Phase B command.
Real projector legibility, real tablets and classroom rhythm not verified.
simulatePlayers: 2/6/15/30 devices, no lost or duplicated responses
manualQA: Browser repro on RC2-A (score delta 200 → score.server_override) and on RC2-A.1 (Photopuzzle +295 and Indovina +290 computed locally → score.verified) with a real /player page. See documentazione_tecnica/QA/TEST_RESULTS_1.0_RC2A1.md
contentPacks: Barocco 3media and Preistoria 1media 1.2.0 (standard times) delivered separately, not inside this ZIP
